new_value: {"assignee":"","notes":"2026-08-27 full current-spec read-only audit: modern canonical signed corpus test/vectors/link_frame_signed_modes.json contains six positive modes/boundaries with LLSec a6/a3/a0/a5/a2/a7, required 8-byte signer EUI-64 after destination, and signed maximum payloads. Current Zephyr frame.c rejects all six immediately because bit7 is declared reserved; writer emits only bit5, rejects any signer field, and sizes payload without the signer octets. It also accepts noncanonical S-only frames instead of enforcing S==SI. Existing host frame test binary passed 16/16, including unsigned bounds/encryption/NULL cases, but its so-called canonical signed tests hard-code stale 0x20/0x21 frames and explicitly assert signer_iid_present=false, so it cannot satisfy the modern positive/negative corpus. Shared frame sources/tests remain read-only due concurrent work. Added exact blocker project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.1.5.4.3; no additional Schnorr dependency is needed because Zephyr deterministic sign/verify implementation beads .1.9.2.3/.1.9.3.3 are already closed. Acceptance remains open until C parses/writes SIID, enforces S==SI, accounts for signer bytes at all max-size boundaries, and consumes the shared positive/malformed vectors.","status":"open"}
